en.about.dataSecurityContent: All your data is stored locally in your browser. The plugin does not collect, upload, or share any of your conversation content or personal information. This project is open-source on GitHub, and the code is available for review at any time.
en.about.developerContent: This project is co-maintained by me and Claude Fable 5, with 1–2 new versions released every week. To request a feature or report a bug, reach out through the channels below (I will definitely reply when I see it):
en.about.pluginContent: Timeline is a productivity plugin built for DeepSeek Harness, featuring timeline, folders, LaTeX formula copying, custom prompts, and more practical tools.
en.changelog.ratingText: If Timeline helped you, share it with your friends. A GitHub Star helps more people discover it!
en.changelog.subtitle: A feature booster for DSH. New version, better experience.
en.changelog.title: Timeline Updated!
